윌로우가 숲의 말을 전했어요.\n내일 하루, 나무를 베지 말래요.\n숲이:

Don't fell any trees tomorrow.

숲이 기억할 거예요.\n내일은 도끼를 쉬게 하고,\n숲이 준 선물 둘을:

…그래요, 마녀님 산장이니까.\n대신 우린 하루쯤 입 다물래요.\n흥,:
...Fine, it's your Lodge, Witch.

Hmph, that means we're hurt.

Far longer than we do.
Take a look at this hammer.
케틸이 두고 간 망치요.\n자루에 룬이 박혔소.\n좋은 쇠요. 아주 좋은:
A hammer Ketil left behind.
There are runes set in the handle.
Good iron. Very good iron.
새벽마다 목재 하나를 쓰지.\n가장 상한 데를 손보오.\n드워프가 들면:

Twice as much in a Dwarf's hands.
흠. 망치보다 나무라.\n틀린 말은 아니오.\n쌓아 둔 판자 두 장 가져:
Hm. Wood over hammer.
Not wrong, I suppose.
Take two of the planks I stacked.
Iron doesn't lie.
Strike it and the truth comes out.
시그뉘가 통 하나를 남겼소.\n검고 무거운 맥주요.\n마시면 몸이 돌처럼:
Signy left a keg behind.
Dark, heavy beer.
Drink it and your body turns to stone.
다들 몸이 단단해지오.\n대신 다리가 좀 무거워지지.\n드워프는 안 무거:
Everyone gets sturdier.

Dwarves don't get heavy, though.
...Refusing a drink?
Fine, I'll sell the keg.
Here's the price.
One cup is medicine.
Two cups are medicine too.
하랄이 그랬소. 나무는 썩고,\n돌은 남는다고.\n여기 돌벽 하나 올립시:

Let's raise a stone wall here.
땅에 놓으면 튼튼히 서오.\n드워프가 셋 이상이면\n새벽마다 조금씩 메우:
Set on the ground, it stands firm.
With three or more Dwarves,
we'll patch it up a bit each dawn.
Hm, wood it is.
Then use these planks
before they rot.
Stone doesn't hurry.

하랄 집안 방패요.\n긁힌 자국마다 조상이 있소.\n한 번도 뚫린 적 없:
A shield of House Harald.
Every scratch holds an ancestor.
Never once pierced.
Give it to the front line.
Whoever carries it gets hurt less.
In a Dwarf's hands,
the comrades beside him hold firm too.
...Well said.
I'll pour a cup for the ancestors
and hand over the leftover coin.
A shield belongs to whoever stands in front.
We'll stand in front tonight too.
토르그림이 나뭇결을 읽었소.\n이건 갱도를 받치던 결이오.\n산장도 받칠:
Thorgrim read the grain of the wood.
This grain once propped up a mine shaft.
It can prop up the Lodge too.
Set it up beside the Lodge.
서 있는 동안 산장이 버티오.\n부러지면 그대로 무너져\n곁의 놈들을 덮:
While it stands, the Lodge holds.

...Well, timber is timber.
Take two bundles.
Read the grain
and you know where the wood will break.
하랄은 늘 벽을 두드리오.\n돌 속에 노래가 있다더군.\n그걸 부르면 돌:

Sing a verse at night

Twice as long with four Dwarves.
Hm. Tone-deaf, are you?
Just joking.
Here, I'll share a bit of my wages.
Give it a knock.
Stone answers back.
가로크가 북을 줬다!\n이 소리면 피가 끓는다!\n오늘 밤 쳐도 되나,:
Garok gave us a drum!

Can we beat it tonight, Witch?

Orcs hit twice as hard!

배부르다고? 거짓말!\n…좋다, 장 본 돈 남았다.\n가져가라!:

가로크는 맹세를 뼈에 새겼다.\n나도 피로 맹세하고 싶다.\n한 번 하면:
Garok carved his oath into bone.
I want to swear in blood too.
Once done, it can't be undone.
오크 하나가 영원히 강해진다!\n대신 다시는 못 내보낸다.\n바칠 수도:

말한 건 지킨다.\n그게 오크다!:

크라냐가 또 자랑한다!\n하나 잡을 때마다 소리 지른다!\n소리 지르면:

Orcs get faster with every kill!

Take the meat!
오늘 밤 숲이 떨 거다!\n오크 목소리에!:

What I hunted today.
Take it.

can sometimes beat a sword.

Just like you, Witch.

bad rumors spread fast.

Auntie Sera says

어느 종족이 좋으세요?\n고르시면 다음에 오는 손님은\n꼭 그쪽 사람일:

그럼 편지값은 아꼈네요.\n세라 아주머니가 이걸 주래요.\n다음 장사 때:

Auntie Sera told me to give you this.
See you at the next trade.

Good ones most of all.
오스윈이 유적에서 찾은 기록이요.\n종족마다의 옛 비결이 적혔대요.\n…:

...But it's a bit eerie.
세 쪽이 펼쳐졌어요.\n그중 하나만 골라 가져가세요.\n나머진 먼지로 돌:

Pick just one to take.
The rest crumble to dust.

...The writing has all faded.
Nothing is readable.
I'll ask Oswin again.
덮으니 공기가 맑아졌어요.\n검은 것 하나가 씻겨 나갔고요.\n없으면 오:

One dark thing was washed away.

shouldn't be opened carelessly.

Auntie Sera's wagon has pulled up.
It's full of goods from far away.
Some from other races, too.
세 가지를 펼쳐 놨어요.\n한 장에 18G씩이래요.\n마음에 드는 것만:
She's laid out three things.
18G per card.
Buy only what you like.
네, 오늘은 그냥 보내죠.\n아주머니가 또 온대요.\n길 조심하라고 했어:
Yes, let's send it on today.
She says she'll come again.
She told us to watch the road.
Merchants always come back.
They always do.
드워프는 맥주, 오크는 스튜.\n둘이 밤새 싸우다가\n한 통에 다 붓기로:

and agreed to pour it all in one pot!
맥주보다 든든하고 안 무겁다!\n먹으면 상처도 반은 붙소.\n둘 다 이긴:
Heartier than beer and not as heavy!
Eat it and half your wounds close.
Both sides win!
Hmph, separate after all.
Then here's the leftover meat for snacks.
Take both.
Growing fond while fighting
is the same for dwarves and orcs.
다들 고향 문장을 하나씩\n천 조각에 꿰매 왔어요.\n산장 깃발로 걸면:

onto a scrap of cloth.
How about hanging it as the Lodge banner?
한 번 걸면 계속 걸려요.\n다른 종족이 셋 이상이면\n모두 더 세게 쳐:
Once hung, it stays hung.
With three or more different races,
everyone hits harder.
That's nice too.
I sold the leftover cloth.
Here's the price.
Crests may differ,
but the wind blows the same way.
여긴 말이 다 달라요.\n떠돌이 통역사가 펜을 두고 갔어요.\n쓰면 서로:

A wandering interpreter left a pen behind.
Use it and people understand each other better.
마녀님 허리에 차 두세요.\n다른 종족 이야기가\n더 자주 들려올 거예요:
Keep it at your belt, Witch.
You'll hear stories of other races
more often.
Ha ha, gestures are words too.
I'll sell the pen and share the money.
Here's your cut.
When people understand each other,
the night is less cold.
종족이 이렇게 많이 모인 건\n처음이래요, 다들.\n한 번 크게 놀아 볼:
Everyone says it's the first time
